svg.title: Finance director — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as finance director, wearing a tailored jacket. Visible work cue: An open two-column budget ledger with a separate short stack of coins above the pages. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Appearance: short hair, an oval face.
